form:FormGroup.label: Key Store Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The format of the key store file: JCEKS, JKS or PKCS12. Default is PKCS12.

form:FormGroup.label: Key Store Pass Phrase (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The pass phrase that unlocks the key store file. Leave blank if it has none.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank if the key store has none.

form:FormGroup.label: Upload Key Store File
form:FormGroup.helpText: The key store file to upload, e.g. a .p12 file. A file is required when creating these credentials or replacing their secret.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Required when creating these credentials or replacing their secret, e.g. a .p12 file.
